runners.title: Replication Data for: Injury Prediction In Competitive Runners With Machine Learning
runners.citation: Lovdal, den Hartigh, Azzopardi (2021), doi:10.34894/UWU9PV, version 2.0.
runners.task: Source injury/no-injury event label from preceding daily or weekly training features. Research only; not a validated individual medical product.

pamap2.title: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring
pamap2.citation: Reiss, A. (2012). PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring [Dataset]. UCI. doi:10.24432/C5NW2H.
pamap2.task: Sensor activity classification; not readiness, longitudinal fatigue, injury or measured hypertrophy.
pamap2.size_note: Landing page: 656.3 MB; nested ZIP. Large acquisition requires an explicit --allow-large flag.

fitrec.title: FitRec / Endomondo
fitrec.license: Academic use only; no commercial use; no redistribution
fitrec.citation: Ni, Muhlstein, McAuley (2019). Modeling heart rate and activity data for personalized fitness recommendation. WWW. https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~jmcauley/pdfs/www19.pdf

garmin.title: Garmin Connect Developer Program
garmin.license: Authenticated authorized API access, not an open training dataset
garmin.task: Future consented user data. Personal tokens require user-owned credentials; Business Starter/Enterprise requires Garmin program application. No authentication or application performed.

hypertrophy-review.title: A Systematic Review of The Effects of Different Resistance Training Volumes on Muscle Hypertrophy
hypertrophy-review.task: Evidence synthesis: seven qualitative/six quantitative studies, trained young men, ultrasound outcomes; not a row-level athlete dataset. No moderate-versus-high difference for quadriceps/biceps, different triceps result. Does not provide labels for AthleteOS.
